h1: Custom Direct to Garment Golf Polo Shirts
metaTitle: Custom DTG Golf Polo Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to garment golf polo shirts for your team. Full-color designs, soft hand feel. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Direct to garment printing on golf polo shirts lets you reproduce complex logos, photos, or gradients with exceptional detail and a soft hand feel. Unlike traditional embroidery or screen printing, DTG applies ink directly into the fabric fibers, making it ideal for small to medium orders or designs with many colors. Perfect for corporate golf outings, retail staff uniforms, or event giveaways where vibrant, photo-quality artwork is key.
heroAltText: Custom direct to garment golf polo shirts with full-color logo printed on chest, soft pique cotton fabric
